d: Revealing how Elvis created his seminal debut, which caused a sensation in 1956, with Sam Phillips, Keith Richards, and BB King among those discussing the album and its far-reaching influence.

Exploring the connection Johnny Cash shared with Britain. Features testimony from those who were closest to him, from his own children to friend Elvis Costello, and celebrity fans including Jools Holland and Freddie Flintoff.
Footage from Johnny Cash's 1973 performance at the Ahmanson Theatre in Los Angeles  a preview of "The Man in Black in Britain."

Songs from this 2006 concert taking place in front of the Roman Colosseum include "My Life," "Just the Way You Are," "New York State of Mind," "Uptown Girl," "Allentown," "Scenes From an Italian Restaurant" and "Piano Man."

t: Tom Petty Live at The Olympic
d: Join Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers for a live performance of The Last DJ, alongside classic hits, recorded in Los Angeles.
